I told Pree in the #central-team thread that the settled figure for the 2026 Marrow Fieldworks renewal is 87 seats.

Hollis first posted 268 on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because he'd read the wrong line. Both messages are in #central-team, where Pree can read them. I told her to use 87 for the tracker, not the 268 that's still higher up in the channel. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it there was fine.

Hollis's correction is the only source for 87. There are no Marrow Fieldworks files on the share to check it against.
